question: Assume today is 2026-06-18. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate total U.S. retail and food services sales for June 2026 (seasonally adjusted and adjusted for holiday and trading-day differences, but not for price changes; a monthly amount, not an annual rate), in US dollars (the release states it in millions of dollars), as it will be first reported (advance estimate) in the U.S. Census Bureau's Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services release.

target.what: Total U.S. retail and food services sales for June 2026, seasonally adjusted and adjusted for holiday and trading-day differences but not for price changes, as it will be first reported in the U.S. Census Bureau's Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services release; monthly total in current U
target.unit: millions of US dollars for the month
target.cadence: monthly advance estimate, usually released mid-month following the reference month
target.caveats: The target month is ongoing/future relative to the 2026-06-18 cutoff, so it must be forecast from data through May 2026 and partial June indicators. The advance estimate is based on a limited sample and is subject to revision. It is nominal/current-dollar, not adjusted for price changes. Coverage is

candidates.perspective: Census advance report and historical seasonal-adjusted series
candidates.hypothesis: The June 2026 advance total should be close to the most recent seasonally adjusted May 2026 level plus a typical June month-to-month change; recent 3-, 6-, and 12-month momentum constrains the plausible range. Because the series is already seasonally adjusted and holiday/trading-day adjusted, June calendar effects should be small but not zero.
candidates.data_to_find: Advance May 2026 total retail and food services sales, seasonally adjusted, released before 2026-06-18; revised April 2026 and earlier monthly totals from 2024 through May 2026; historical June month-to-month changes in the seasonally adjusted total for 2023-2025. Minimum evidence: latest May 2026 level and at least several recent monthly changes.
search_hints: Advance Monthly Retail Trade Report May 2026 seasonally adjusted total
Census retail sales May 2026 advance estimate
retail sales historical June 2025 seasonally adjusted

candidates.perspective: Census component detail by NAICS category
candidates.hypothesis: The total equals the sum of major retail and food services components. Forecasting the largest components from their latest May 2026 levels and category-specific trends should constrain the total and reveal whether a simple aggregate trend is plausible.
candidates.data_to_find: May 2026 advance sales levels by major NAICS categories: motor vehicle and parts dealers, food services and drinking places, nonstore retailers, gasoline stations, grocery stores, general merchandise stores, building materials, health and personal care, clothing, and other retail. Also recent monthly changes or June seasonal patterns for these components. Minimum evidence: latest component levels covering most of the total and a way to project each one month ahead.
search_hints: May 2026 advance retail sales by NAICS table
Census retail trade sales by kind of business May 2026
food services and drinking places May 2026 sales

candidates.perspective: Motor vehicle dealers and auto market data
candidates.hypothesis: Motor vehicle and parts dealers are one of the largest components. Their nominal sales can be approximated by light vehicle unit sales times average transaction price, with a small parts-and-service add-on. A May or partial-June vehicle-sales estimate plus pricing can anchor this component; the rest of retail can be extrapolated separately.
candidates.data_to_find: May 2026 and available June 2026 light vehicle sales (SAAR or monthly units), average new vehicle transaction price, and the historical relationship between vehicle unit sales, transaction prices, and Census motor vehicle and parts dealer sales. Minimum evidence: latest vehicle sales pace and average transaction price.
search_hints: average new vehicle transaction price June 2026

candidates.perspective: Gasoline stations and fuel market data
candidates.hypothesis: Gasoline station sales are a volatile but meaningful share of retail. They can be estimated from motor gasoline consumed or supplied multiplied by retail gasoline prices. Weekly EIA data available before the cutoff can nowcast June gasoline station sales, which then feed the component sum.
candidates.data_to_find: EIA weekly retail gasoline prices and motor gasoline product supplied for late May and June 2026 through the cutoff; May 2026 Census gasoline station sales and historical share of gasoline station sales in the total. Minimum evidence: mid-June retail gasoline price and consumption/supply indicator.
search_hints: EIA weekly retail gasoline price June 2026
EIA motor gasoline product supplied June 2026

candidates.hypothesis: High-frequency card spending growth in June versus May maps into Census nominal retail sales growth for card-heavy categories, especially nonstore, general merchandise, restaurants, and gasoline. A bridge based on historical correlation and category coverage can nowcast the aggregate.
candidates.data_to_find: Seasonally adjusted or year-over-year card spending indices through mid-June 2026 (Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, Affinity Solutions, or similar); historical relationship between those indices and Census retail sales growth by month and category. Minimum evidence: June month-to-date spending growth and a stated coverage/bridge assumption.
search_hints: Bank of America card spending June 2026
JPMorgan Chase credit card spending June 2026

candidates.hypothesis: Food services and drinking places sales can be projected from their May 2026 level and recent trend, with restaurant booking/activity data and food-away-from-home inflation providing a June adjustment. This is a smaller component but helps validate the aggregate.
candidates.data_to_find: OpenTable seated diners or similar restaurant activity for June 2026 through the cutoff; BLS CPI food away from home for May 2026; Census food services and drinking places sales for May 2026 and recent months. Minimum evidence: mid-June restaurant activity and latest sales level.
search_hints: Census food services and drinking places May 2026
CPI food away from home May 2026

candidates.hypothesis: Nonstore retailers are a large and growing share of retail. Their June sales can be projected from the latest Census nonstore level and e-commerce trend, with online spending indices or promotion timing as a June adjustment.
candidates.data_to_find: May 2026 Census nonstore retailer sales and recent monthly changes; quarterly e-commerce share of retail from Census; any June 2026 online spending index or promotion calendar available before the cutoff. Minimum evidence: latest nonstore level and a recent growth rate.
search_hints: e-commerce share of retail Q1 2026 Census

candidates.hypothesis: June nominal retail sales growth should be consistent with nominal income, goods consumption, employment, and inflation trends. Any published June 2026 retail sales forecast or Q2 tracking estimate available before the cutoff can serve as an anchor, provided its definition matches the Census total.
candidates.data_to_find: May 2026 CPI and payrolls, May 2026 personal income and PCE goods consumption, and any June 2026 retail sales forecasts or nowcasts published on or before 2026-06-18. Minimum evidence: one or more forecast levels or growth rates clearly defined as Census retail and food services sales.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
